description: This file defines a 'CreateTripScreen' component for a travel planning app, presenting a UI form to create a new trip with placeholder data, and methods to handle trip creation and navigation.

classes.name: CreateTripScreen
classes.description: A Lightning.js component responsible for rendering the Create Trip screen and handling user interactions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new trip with static data and navigates to the trip detail page.

methods.name: goBack
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous screen.
